Frontend.reason: Word records now join the canonical Phase 4B source-data snapshot and use the existing local-first transaction, cross-tab pulse, revision trigger, byte-capped batch and conflict path. The word entry dialog now waits for the local transaction result before closing, so a lock or storage failure is visible rather than silently losing the edit. Dashboard totals, XP, badges and activity projections remain local derivations and are never sent as word-record payload fields. Tracker also upgrades its account dialog into a personal center: it shows the shared Lexi login, recent account devices, local sign-out, and a two-step permanent-account-deletion flow. After a server-confirmed deletion, only this browser origin's Tracker records, session marker and durable Phase 4B outbox are cleared; other devices and the separate Words browser origin are accurately disclosed as outside this page's local-storage reach.

Backend.reason: A paired Formal release is required before enablement: add word_record to Tracker capabilities and the private sync validator with the same exact raw fields and byte/count/date/timestamp bounds, while preserving ownership, optimistic versions, tombstone cleanup and aggregate byte accounting. The Tracker client will remain paused rather than send a partially compatible record set until that capability is present. The permanent shared-account deletion endpoint must authenticate the bearer identity server-side, require the fixed confirmation payload, delete only that Auth user using a server-only credential, revoke sessions through Auth deletion, and never expose a service-role credential or another user's identity to the browser. Existing user_devices RLS is reused for recent-device display.

Admin.reason: The paired Lexi Control release must include word_record in Tracker sync aggregate capacity/reporting and contract coverage, without exposing learner notes or content. It must also expose only aggregate account-deletion health if the new deletion audit is measured. No per-record administrator browsing or editing surface is required.

Deployment.reason: Not deployed. First apply and verify the backward-compatible Formal word_record validator/RPC and protected lexi-account-delete function; then use protected Lexi Control authority to enable the new kind (the old four-kind client safely ignores it); only then deploy this strict five-kind Tracker client. Finally smoke-test word create/update/delete, second-device pull, restart/offline retry, byte-limit rejection, cross-account isolation, aggregate byte metrics, account device list, local sign-out, and permanent deletion with a disposable account only.

Verification.reason: Focused word payload, Phase 4B runtime, canonical store, cross-tab, IndexedDB-clear, account-deletion request and local-cleanup tests must pass with Tracker typecheck/lint. Before a release, run both full release gates, verify the shared validator/RLS/RPC, protected function CORS/auth behavior and Lexi Control aggregate output, then perform the paired signed-in production smoke checks.
